ENV=dev

# LiteLLM Proxy
# LITELLM_BASE_URL=<set me in .env>
# LITELLM_MASTER_KEY="<set me in .env>"

# Temporal
TEMPORAL_HOST=localhost:7233
TEMPORAL_TASK_QUEUE=llm
TEMPORAL_S3_BUCKET_NAME=temporal-payloads
TEMPORAL_S3_ENDPOINT_URL=http://localhost:9000
# TEMPORAL_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=<set me in .env>
# TEMPORAL_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=<set me in .env>
TEMPORAL_S3_REGION=eu-west-1

# Worker tuning
QUEUES='[
  {"NAME": "llm-nvidia",  "MAX_CONCURRENT": 3, "MAX_PER_SECOND": 5},
  {"NAME": "llm-ionos",   "MAX_CONCURRENT": 8,  "MAX_PER_SECOND": 10},
  {"NAME": "llm-mistral", "MAX_CONCURRENT": 8,  "MAX_PER_SECOND": 15},
=====fpp=====

observation.command: cd /workspace && cat 04-shared-services/llm/llm-client/.env.local 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "=====fpp====="; grep -E "LITELLM|OPENAI|API" 02-backend/fpp_service/.env.local 2>/dev/null | head -20
